normAttorneyId.description: Identifier of the attorney to track

stateCodeArray.description: Required array of state codes indicating where the attorney is barred. Can be empty [] to consider all barred states.

scheduleOptions.startDate.description: Optional start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be today or a future date.

scheduleOptions.endDate.description: Optional end date (YYYY-MM-DD) to stop tracking after this date.

notifyOnDelay.description: Ignored for Norm Attorney Track; always treated as false.
